commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
90+5' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Manchester Utd.
90+2' Close! Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
90+1' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90+1' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Andre Onana thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
90' Manchester Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

89' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester Utd.
88' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) attempts to find Rasmus Hojlund, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
85' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Mason Mount (Manchester United) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Amad Diallo.
84' Mason Mount (Manchester United) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
82' Mason Mount (Manchester United) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' Substitution. Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) has come on for Micky van de Ven.
77' 0 - 3 Goal! Pape Matar Sarr gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Dominic Solanke (Tottenham), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 0:3.
77' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
77' A substitution has been made. Timo Werner is replaced by Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is coming onto the pitch as James Maddison cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Here is a change. Brennan Johnson is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Mikey Moore (Tottenham).

76' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
76' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from James Maddison (Tottenham) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
74' The free kick is delivered by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
73' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Pedro Porro (Tottenham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
73' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marcus Rashford will be replaced by Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United).
73' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) replaces Manuel Ugarte.

72' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
72' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
70' Casemiro (Manchester United) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
68' Timo Werner (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andre Onana, who smothers the ball.
66' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes a short free kick.
65' Yellow card! It's like Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Chris Kavanagh agrees and books him.
64' A dangerous towering header by Casemiro (Manchester United) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
63' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) will deliver the corner kick.
63' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Manchester Utd win a corner.
62' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Manchester Utd! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Chris Kavanagh and both teams have no complaints.
61' Referee Chris Kavanagh makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
61' That looked a certain handball by Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
60' The resulting corner from Mason Mount (Manchester United) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.
59' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Manchester Utd will take a corner kick.
58' Wonderful movement by Tottenham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
57' Timo Werner (Tottenham) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
55' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Djed Spence (Tottenham) for a tough tackle.
53' A pass travels right across the box to Pedro Porro (Tottenham) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana denies him with a decent save.
52' Djed Spence (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:5.

47' 0 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
47' Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight and sees a foul from James Maddison (Tottenham).
46' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Djed Spence (Tottenham) replacing Destiny Udogie.
46' Erik ten Hag makes a half-time substitution. Casemiro comes on in place of Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Tottenham are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
45+4' Mason Mount (Manchester United) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Chris Kavanagh ignores the protests.
45+2' Timo Werner (Tottenham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
45+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham). Chris Kavanagh doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Mason Mount (Manchester United) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kobbie Mainoo.
42' We have witnessed a sending-off! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is given a red card for his dangerous challenge. Chris Kavanagh's decision is final.
41' The resulting corner from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is cleared.
39' The foul by Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Chris Kavanagh.
39' What an amazing save by Andre Onana! Timo Werner (Tottenham) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.

37' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.

37' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
35' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to find Alejandro Garnacho, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
34' The expression of the referee Chris Kavanagh is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is shown a yellow card.

33' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
33' The resulting corner comes to nothing as James Maddison (Tottenham) sends it out of play.

32' He should have scored! Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Tottenham force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

30' James Maddison (Tottenham) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
30' James Maddison (Tottenham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
27' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
24' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) tries to find Alejandro Garnacho, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
22' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Guglielmo Vicario.
21' The game is interrupted now, Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
19' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United).
18' Rough tackle by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
14' A pass from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is intercepted by Guglielmo Vicario and the move breaks down.
14' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. James Maddison (Tottenham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
13' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.
12' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
11' What a sweet touch by James Maddison (Tottenham) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Andre Onana to hold.
10' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
9' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Timo Werner (Tottenham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
5' Manchester Utd keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! Micky van de Ven feeds Brennan Johnson (Tottenham), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:1.
3' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
2' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
1' The first half has just begun.
Manchester Utd will kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
